name: Iru
overview: Iru is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified in Scripture primarily as the son of Caleb. His mention is brief and focused on his lineage, without additional narrative or descriptive details.
namesAndTitles: The name Iru appears as a proper name in Scripture without a provided meaning or divine origin. Therefore, it is recognized simply as a biblical personal name recorded in 1 Chronicles 4:15.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Iru as the son of Caleb, establishing his place within the genealogy of Judah. No other family relationships are detailed beyond this filial connection.
scriptureSignificance: Iru's significance lies chiefly in his genealogical connection to Caleb, a prominent figure in the tribe of Judah. His mention in 1 Chronicles situates him within the broader biblical record of Israel's tribal heritage, underscoring the importance of lineage in God's unfolding plan. Though little else is recorded, his inclusion reflects the biblical emphasis on preserving the memory of God's people and their descendants.
